items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: So years later, when I met Jabbo, and I went to rehearsal with his band

ctx.x: I thought he had his own band.

Oh, later on he might have had it, yes. But I know when I first heard him. No, Jabbo, that was later. Yeah. Incidentally, do you know that Jabbo was in that little Cull of the Kids orphan band that came from the South? Yes, Jenkins. Yes. And I saw them, this is odd, I saw them on the street in Chicago when I first came here. They were a little bunch of kids. And there was one little guy there. He seemed to be in charge of everybody. He was a take charge guy. And he played the terrific trumpet. So years later,…

Well, being an orphan. Yeah. Being on his own all the time. Yeah. It was bound to affect his psychology. He wasn't as mellow as a lot of people. I don't think he is today. In fact, he doesn't even trust himself.
